title: ToDoPro: Faster and Better Reference-Based Generation: Early Token Reduction via Downsampled Self-Probing
title_zh: ToDoPro：通过下采样自探测实现早期Token缩减，实现更快更好的基于参考的生成

paragraphs.en: Recent generic reference-based image generation models natively support multiple conditions by concatenating all reference image and text tokens into a joint sequence processed by a single Diffusion Transformer (DiT). However, this versatile paradigm comes at an efficiency cost: accommodating multiple references leads to a token explosion, incurring massive 𝒪 ⁡ ( N 2 ) \mathcal{O}(N^{2}) computational complexity. Most acceleration methods operate inside the DiT, showing limited capability in reducing spatial redundancy and failing to alleviate peak VRAM. While some pre-model token reduction alternatives exist, they inevitably introduce external models. This raises a question: Is it possible to achieve acceleration and memory savings while preserving compatibility with in-model techniques and requiring no additional parameters? In this work, we realize this goal by proposing the early To ken reduction via Do wnsampled self- Pro bing ( ToDoPro ). By executing a few denoising steps on spatially 2 × 2\times downsampled reference images, this cheap probing stage utilizes the DiT model itself to effectively and efficiently extract reference token importance. Using the probed importance, we apply a hierarchical reduction before the main denoising stage: we completely discard low-importance tokens, substitute mid-importance tokens with their downsampled counterparts to cheaply preserve global context, and keep high-importance tokens. Experiments across three base models and two benchmarks demonstrate that our early reduction accelerates inference significantly and mitigates peak GPU memory. Furthermore, we can improve generation quality by safely filtering out noisy, uninformative reference tokens, enabling the model to concentrate its limited attention capacity on genuinely useful tokens. The code will be released at https://github.com/scy639/ToDoPro

paragraphs.en: Reference-based image generation and editing have fundamentally transformed visual synthesis, moving beyond pure text prompts to multimodal control. By allowing multiple reference inputs, these models achieve greater controllability, driving increasing demand in domains such as advertising and design. However, incorporating multiple reference images massively expands the token sequence length. Due to the 𝒪 ⁡ ( N 2 ) \mathcal{O}(N^{2}) nature of attention, this token explosion significantly increases both the latency and peak VRAM , limiting the number of references and resolutions that can be practically supported. The token explosion also degrades the generation quality due to: 1) Attention interference: some irrelevant reference tokens inevitably attract anomalous attention, interfering with the generation process; 2) Attention dilution: The explosion in the number of tokens leads to a massive denominator in the attention Softmax, diluting weights of truly important tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 基于参考图像的生成与编辑从根本上改变了视觉合成，超越了纯文本提示，走向多模态控制。 通过允许多个参考输入，这些模型获得了更强的可控性，推动了广告和设计等领域日益增长的需求。 然而，引入多张参考图像会大幅扩展 token 序列的长度。 由于注意力机制的 𝒪 ⁡ ( N 2 ) \mathcal{O}(N^{2}) 特性，这种 token 爆炸显著增加了推理延迟和显存峰值占用，限制了实际可支持的参考数量和分辨率。 token 爆炸还会降低生成质量，原因在于：1) 注意力干扰：一些无关的参考 token 不可避免地吸引异常注意力，干扰生成过程；2) 注意力稀释：token 数量的爆炸式增长导致注意力 Softmax 中的分母急剧增大，稀释了真正重要 token 的权重。

paragraphs.en: Despite growing works on efficient AI, a satisfying solution for generic reference-based generation is still missing. Most token reduction methods operate inside the DiT, pruning or merging tokens only after the full sequence has already entered the model. Therefore, they fail to reduce peak VRAM, which typically occurs at the earliest attention layers before reduction takes place. Some methods can reduce tokens before the main model, but they either degrade performance noticeably [ 5 ] , limiting their practicality. Thus, to reduce peak memory and maintain compatibility with most DiT acceleration methods, we target an early reduction approach, meaning the token reduction is performed before the main denoising such that the entire main denoising process uses the reduced token sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管关于高效AI的研究日益增多，但目前仍然缺乏一种令人满意的通用基于参考的生成解决方案。 大多数token缩减方法都在DiT内部运行，只有在完整序列进入模型之后才进行token的剪枝或合并。 因此，它们无法降低峰值显存占用，而峰值显存占用通常发生在缩减发生之前最早的注意力层。 一些方法可以在主模型之前缩减token，但它们要么会明显降低性能 [ 5 ] ，要么限制了其实用性。 因此，为了降低峰值显存占用并保持与大多数DiT加速方法的兼容性，我们采用早期缩减方法，即在主去噪之前执行token缩减，使得整个主去噪过程使用缩减后的token序列。

paragraphs.en: One straightforward early reduction method is to use an external model to identify unimportant regions [ 65 ] , which introduces extra parameters and lacks alignment with the generator’s actual demands. Another method is to utilize internal features, such as attention maps, to estimate token importance. Yet, attention patterns for token importance remain unexplored in reference-based image generation, and insights from adjacent fields like ViTs/VLMs and text-to-image (T2I) are inapplicable to our task due to fundamental differences: Unlike VLMs, where visual tokens mainly provide high-level semantics, our task relies heavily on fine-grained, low-level reference details; T2I acceleration focuses on cross-timestep temporal redundancy rather than spatial token redundancy.
paragraphs.zh: 一种直接的早期缩减方法是使用外部模型来识别不重要的区域 [ 65 ]，但这会引入额外的参数，且缺乏与生成器实际需求的对齐。 另一种方法是利用内部特征（如注意力图）来估计词元的重要性。 然而，词元重要性的注意力模式在基于参考图的图像生成中仍未被探索，而来自相邻领域（如 ViTs/VLMs 和文生图 T2I）的见解也不适用于我们的任务，原因在于根本性的差异：与 VLMs 中视觉词元主要提供高层语义不同，我们的任务严重依赖细粒度的低层参考细节；T2I 加速关注的是跨时间步的时间冗余，而非空间词元冗余。

paragraphs.en: Thus, we firstly perform an in-depth analysis of attention, yielding two key observations: First, the total attention that generative and prompt tokens pay to a reference token, termed the reference utilization score , correlates well with its actual importance, thus serving as an effective proxy. Second, although some unimportant reference tokens inevitably exhibit anomalous attention scores, these abnormal tokens are stochastic and vary across layers. Furthermore, a single layer is usually biased because different layers may have different functions and focuses. Computing the mean utilization score across layers smooths out the bias and instantaneous noise observed in any individual layer, ensuring meaningless tokens are accurately identified, and yielding a robust importance estimation. This reveals a pathway to address degradation: reducing the number of uninformative tokens mitigates attention dilution and interference, and averaging across layers further mitigates interference by identifying unimportant tokens more accurately.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们首先对注意力进行了深入分析，得到两个关键观察结果：其一，生成词元和提示词元对一个参考词元所付出的总注意力，即参考利用率分数，与其实际重要性高度相关，因此可以作为有效的替代指标。 其二，尽管一些不重要的参考词元不可避免地会表现出异常的注意力分数，但这些异常词元是随机的，并且在不同的层之间各不相同。 此外，仅凭单层通常会有偏差，因为不同层可能具有不同的功能和关注点。 对各层的利用率分数取平均，可以平滑掉任何单层中观察到的偏差和瞬时噪声，从而确保无意义词元被准确识别，并得到稳健的重要性估计。 这揭示了一条解决退化的途径：减少无信息词元的数量可以缓解注意力稀释和干扰，而跨层取平均则通过更准确地识别不重要词元，进一步缓解干扰。

paragraphs.en: However, extracting attention maps during main denoising loop cannot prevent the VRAM spike and impairs compatibility with in-model acceleration methods, contradicting the goal of early reduction. Thus, we propose our early token reduction via spatial-temporal downsampled self-probing , which identifies unimportant tokens in a cheap probing denoising stage and prunes or replaces them prior to the main denoising. By executing a temporally downsampled, few-step denoising on spatially 2 × 2\times downsampled images, this probing stage cheaply approximates attention of full-resolution loop. Then, we adopt different policies for each 2 × 2 2\times 2 block of full-resolution reference tokens, guided by importance score of its corresponding downsampled reference token: High-importance blocks remain intact (preserving all 4 tokens), whereas low-importance blocks are completely discarded. To prevent quality drops from losing broader mid-importance context at high pruning rates, we introduce an intermediate level, replacing mid-importance blocks with the corresponding downsampled reference token instead of completely discarding them, cheaply capturing global context.

paragraphs.en: This early reduction yields three major benefits: (1) Because tokens are reduced before the entire main denoising stage, computational savings apply to every timestep and layer, slashing FLOPs significantly and mitigating peak VRAM. (2) It is inherently orthogonal, complementary with existing in-model acceleration techniques (e.g., feature caching and in-model token reduction). (3) The self-probing design utilizes the generator itself, naturally ensuring optimal alignment with the model’s actual demands while avoiding external models.
paragraphs.zh: 这种早期削减带来三大好处：(1) 由于在主去噪阶段开始之前就削减了 token，因此计算节省适用于每个时间步和每一层，显著降低 FLOPs 并缓解显存峰值。 (2) 它具有天然的独立性，可与现有的模型内加速技术（如特征缓存和模型内 token 削减）互补。 (3) 自探测设计利用生成器本身，天然保证了与模型实际需求的最佳对齐，同时避免了使用外部模型。

paragraphs.en: More importantly, our method does not sacrifice performance for efficiency; rather, it comprehensively enhances generation quality. By discarding low-importance tokens, our method mitigates attention interference and dilution issues, allowing the model to better concentrate its limited attention capacity on prompt and generative tokens and genuinely informative reference tokens, ultimately improving overall generation quality.

paragraphs.en: Our key contributions are threefold: (1) We present the first in-depth analysis of attention in generic reference-based diffusion models. This analysis uncovers two key observations regarding reference utilization, and layer-wise bias and noise, establishing a reliable proxy for reference token importance. (2) Guided by these insights, we propose a training-free, early token reduction framework, which is inherently compatible with the existing ecosystem of in-model acceleration. (3) Experiments across three base models and two benchmarks show that our method delivers up to 3 × 3\times mean speedups, cuts peak activation VRAM by up to 50 % 50\% , and consistently improves generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要贡献有三点：(1) 我们首次对基于通用参考的扩散模型中的注意力机制进行了深入分析。 该分析揭示了两点关于参考利用以及逐层偏差与噪声的关键观察，并为参考 token 的重要性建立了一个可靠的代理指标。 (2) 基于这些洞察，我们提出了一种无需训练的早期 token 削减框架，该框架天然与现有的模型内加速生态兼容。 (3) 在三个基础模型和两个基准上的实验表明，我们的方法可实现高达 3 × 3\times 的平均加速，将峰值激活显存最多削减 50 % 50\%，并持续提升生成质量。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models have achieved success in text-to-image generation, motivating extensive work extending them to reference-conditioned generation or editing. These methods incorporate diverse visual conditions (e.g., masks, layouts, subject images, exemplar pairs, and pose maps) to achieve fine-grained controllability. Many methods [ 30 , 54 , 42 , 57 , 8 , 53 , 22 ] integrated references via dedicated control encoders, adapters, or condition-selection mechanisms. While effective in their target tasks, they rely heavily on task-tailored architectures or input assumptions, limiting scalability.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型在文生图领域取得了成功，这促使大量工作将其扩展到基于参考条件的生成或编辑任务。 这些方法引入多种视觉条件（例如掩码、布局、主体图像、示例对和姿态图），以实现细粒度的可控性。 许多方法[30, 54, 42, 57, 8, 53, 22]通过专用的控制编码器、适配器或条件选择机制来整合参考信息。 尽管这些方法在各自目标任务上表现有效，但它们严重依赖为特定任务定制的架构或输入假设，限制了可扩展性。

paragraphs.en: More recently, general-purpose models have emerged to unify diverse conditioning, generation, and editing tasks within a shared DiT backbone [ 4 , 58 , 55 , 70 ] by concatenating reference, text, and generative tokens into a single sequence. This paradigm supports arbitrary reference counts and resolutions, covering diverse downstream tasks. However, this generality comes at a steep cost: token counts and quadratic self-attention complexity explode with additional references. This work focuses on this emerging general-purpose paradigm, which is more versatile and representative of future directions.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，通用模型开始出现，它们通过将参考、文本和生成 token 拼接成单一序列，在共享的 DiT 主干中统一了多样的条件控制、生成与编辑任务 [4, 58, 55, 70]。 这一范式支持任意数量的参考和任意分辨率，覆盖了多样的下游任务。 然而，这种通用性付出了高昂的代价：token 数量和二次方复杂度的自注意力计算会随着参考的增多而急剧膨胀。 本工作聚焦于这一新兴的通用范式，它更加多功能，也更能代表未来的发展方向。

paragraphs.en: Token reduction, also named as token compression, has been explored to improve vision model efficiency (including ViTs and MLLMs) by shortening the token sequence [ 47 , 62 , 24 , 43 ] . One major category is in-model token reduction, which progressively discards or merges tokens during the forward pass of the main model [ 25 , 16 ] . Another category is pre-model token reduction, which compresses tokens before entering the main model. Among these, training-free methods like similarity-based token merging [ 5 ] can achieve this goal without introducing extra trainable modules, though their performance is bounded. Some works [ 60 , 19 , 46 , 2 ] exploit CLS-to-token attention from a vision encoder to prune tokens before feeding them to VLMs. Other works [ 65 , 36 ] adopt more precise methods to predict region importance, but at the cost of introducing new external models.
paragraphs.zh: Token缩减（也称为token压缩）已被探索用于通过缩短token序列来提升视觉模型（包括ViT和MLLM）的效率[47, 62, 24, 43]。 一大类是模型内token缩减，即在主模型的前向传播过程中逐步丢弃或合并token[25, 16]。 另一类是模型前token缩减，即在进入主模型之前对token进行压缩。 其中，像基于相似度的token合并[5]这类无需训练的方法可以在不引入额外可训练模块的情况下实现这一目标，但其性能受限。 一些工作[60, 19, 46, 2]利用视觉编码器的CLS-to-token注意力，在将token输入VLM之前对其进行剪枝。 另一些工作[65, 36]采用更精确的方法来预测区域重要性，但代价是引入了新的外部模型。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion acceleration has been investigated from multiple complementary perspectives. Cross-step caching methods [ 39 , 12 , 77 , 32 , 68 , 38 , 69 , 50 , 48 , 64 , 73 ] reuse features or attention maps across denoising steps to eliminate redundant computation. Distillation methods [ 37 , 45 ] reduce sampling steps, model pruning [ 7 , 20 , 75 ] removes structural weights, quantization [ 27 , 10 ] lowers arithmetic precision, and in-model token reduction methods [ 9 , 21 , 74 , 15 , 28 , 66 ] compress tokens inside models.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散加速已从多个互补的角度得到研究。 跨步缓存方法 [ 39 , 12 , 77 , 32 , 68 , 38 , 69 , 50 , 48 , 64 , 73 ] 在去噪步之间复用特征或注意力图，以消除冗余计算。 蒸馏方法 [ 37 , 45 ] 减少采样步数，模型剪枝 [ 7 , 20 , 75 ] 移除结构权重，量化 [ 27 , 10 ] 降低算术精度，模型内 token 缩减方法 [ 9 , 21 , 74 , 15 , 28 , 66 ] 压缩模型内部的 token。

paragraphs.en: Closer to our reference-based generation setting, several works accelerate specific conditional generation scenarios. RegionE and SpotEdit [ 44 , 13 ] reduce computation on unchanged regions in image editing, but they are limited to layout-preserving single-image editing setting. OmniControl2 [ 56 ] removes near-zero tokens in Canny edge maps and requires re-training. EVCtrl [ 61 ] reduces computation within ControlNet, and ToPi [ 31 ] accelerates in-context generation by pruning tokens inside the main denoising stage.
paragraphs.zh: 与我们基于参考图的生成设定更接近的是，一些工作针对特定的条件生成场景进行了加速。 RegionE 和 SpotEdit [ 44 , 13 ] 通过减少图像编辑中未变化区域的计算量来加速，但它们仅适用于保持布局的单图编辑设定。 OmniControl2 [ 56 ] 移除 Canny 边缘图中接近零的 token，并且需要重新训练。 EVCtrl [ 61 ] 减少 ControlNet 内部的计算量，而 ToPi [ 31 ] 通过在主去噪阶段内剪枝 token 来加速上下文生成。

paragraphs.en: Attention scores are widely adopted as a proxy for token importance in ViTs and VLMs, where prior works observe the rule that visual information rapidly aggregates into a few ”anchor” tokens during early layers, allowing most computationally silent vision tokens to be safely pruned [ 60 , 11 ] . While visual tokens in VLMs primarily serve high-level semantic understanding, our task relies heavily on them to continuously provide fine-grained, low-level spatial details for generation. Thus, the rules observed in VLMs cannot be trivially transferred to our task. Furthermore, acceleration methods in text-to-image (T2I) generation primarily focus on cross-timestep temporal feature similarity. Given that the intermediate feature dynamics within generic reference-based generation models remain largely unexplored, we first perform an in-depth analysis of the attention patterns specific to this task.
paragraphs.zh: 注意力分数在视觉Transformer（ViT）和视觉语言模型（VLM）中被广泛用作词元重要性的替代指标，先前的工作观察到这样一个规律：视觉信息会在早期层中迅速聚合到少数「锚点」词元上，使得大多数计算上沉默的视觉词元可以被安全地剪枝 [60, 11]。 虽然视觉语言模型中的视觉词元主要服务于高层语义理解，但我们的任务严重依赖它们持续提供细粒度、低层的空间细节以供生成使用。 因此，在视觉语言模型中观察到的规律不能被简单地迁移到我们的任务中。 此外，文本到图像（T2I）生成中的加速方法主要关注跨时间步的时间特征相似性。 鉴于通用基于参考的生成模型内部的中间特征动态在很大程度上仍未被探索，我们首先对该任务特有的注意力模式进行了深入分析。

paragraphs.en: We first explore how to quantify reference token importance using the model’s intrinsic attention behaviour. Intuitively, a reference token’s importance should be proportional to the attention it attracts during the denoising pass. For a given reference token r r , we define the reference utilization score queried by a specific query set Ω \Omega as I r t , l ​ ( Ω ) = ∑ i ∈ Ω A i , r t , l I_{r}^{t,l}(\Omega)=\sum_{i\in\Omega}A_{i,r}^{t,l} and evaluate query combinations, including Ω ∈ { G , P , G ∪ P , G ∪ P ∪ R } \Omega\in\{G,P,G\cup P,G\cup P\cup R\} : Ω = G \Omega=G (generative tokens only), Ω = P \Omega=P (prompt tokens only), Ω = G ∪ P \Omega=G\cup P , and Ω = G ∪ P ∪ R \Omega=G\cup P\cup R . To establish a pseudo ground-truth, we define the oracle importance I r ∗ I_{r}^{*} as the gradient magnitude of the final decoded image pixels with respect to each reference token: I r ∗ = ‖ ∇ R r ( ‖ Decode ⁡ ( G 0 , L ) ‖ 2 ) ‖ 2 I_{r}^{*}=\left\|\nabla_{R_{r}}\bigl(\|\operatorname{Decode}(G^{0,L})\|_{2}\bigr)\right\|_{2} , which reflects each reference token’s impact on the generated result [ 1 ] . Then, we evaluate the alignment between this gold standard and our proposed attention-based proxy via Spearman’s rank correlation ρ rank ​ ( 𝐈 ⁡ ( Ω ) , 𝐈 ∗ ) \rho_{\text{rank}}(\mathbf{I}(\Omega),\mathbf{I}^{*}) , which evaluates relative token prioritization, and cosine similarity ρ cos ​ ( 𝐈 ⁡ ( Ω ) , 𝐈 ∗ ) \rho_{\cos}(\mathbf{I}(\Omega),\mathbf{I}^{*}) .

At 0% reduction, the baseline leaks a floating glove from a salient but irrelevant region in ref 2; Moving into a broad optimal window, Factor 1 dominates, and the model successfully filters out these visual distractors. As the reduction ratio escalates to extreme levels ( > > 95%), Factor 2 eventually takes over. Crucial features are irreversibly pruned, resulting in degraded reference consistency. paragraphs.en: Our method can effectively mitigate attention dilution and attention interference, thus making the model allocate its limited attention capacity to genuinely useful reference tokens. Here, we explicitly validate whether the model’s attention is more focused on meaningful reference regions, by evaluating the Effective Attention Ratio (EAR).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法能够有效缓解注意力稀释和注意力干扰，从而使模型将有限的注意力容量分配给真正有用的参考词元。 在这里，我们通过评估有效注意力比率（EAR），明确验证模型的注意力是否更加集中于有意义的参考区域。

sents.zh: 在这里，我们通过评估有效注意力比率（EAR），明确验证模型的注意力是否更加集中于有意义的参考区域。

paragraphs.en: To calculate EAR, an objective ground-truth (GT) importance map is required. While general reference-based tasks lack such GT importance, the object composition task in MultiBanana [ 41 ] inherently aims to composite the salient object in each reference image. Thus, the salient object region (extracted via BiRefNet [ 71 ] ) naturally serves as the GT important area. A higher ratio indicates that the model allocates more attention to genuinely useful regions. We evaluate four variants: (1) Baseline (No Reduction) , the unpruned reference sequence; (2) Top-1 layer , using the utilization score from the best-aligned single layer; (3) Top 20% of layers , using the mean over the top 20% best-correlated layers; and (4) All layers , using the mean across all layers. Details are in Appendix B.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 计算 EAR 需要一个客观的真值（GT）重要性图。 虽然一般的基于参考的任务缺乏这样的 GT 重要性，但 MultiBanana [41] 中的物体合成任务本身就旨在合成每张参考图像中的显著物体。 因此，显著物体区域（通过 BiRefNet [71] 提取）自然可以作为 GT 重要区域。 该比值越高，说明模型将更多注意力分配给了真正有用的区域。 我们评估了四种变体：(1) 基线（无缩减），即未剪枝的参考序列；(2) Top-1 层，使用对齐最佳的单层的利用率分数；(3) Top 20% 层，使用相关性最高的前 20% 层的均值；(4) 所有层，使用所有层的均值。 详细内容见附录 B.5。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose an early token reduction framework via downsampled self-probing to address the token explosion in reference-based diffusion models. By utilizing the model itself to cheaply extract token importance, we perform a tri-tier reduction before the main denoising stage. Experiments show that our training-free method reduces latency, mitigate peak VRAM, seamlessly compounds with in-model acceleration techniques, and improves generation quality.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了一种通过下采样自探测实现的早期词元削减框架，以解决基于参考的扩散模型中的词元爆炸问题。 通过利用模型自身以低成本提取词元重要性，我们在主去噪阶段之前执行三级削减。 实验表明，我们的免训练方法降低了延迟，缓解了显存峰值占用，可与模型内加速技术无缝叠加，并提升了生成质量。

paragraphs.en: Our method is naturally orthogonal and complementary to existing acceleration methods from two perspectives:
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法在两个方面与现有的加速方法天然正交且互补：

paragraphs.en: Stage-level Compatibility: Most existing acceleration methods operate as in-model token reduction , which prunes or merges tokens inside the model during the main denoising loop. In contrast, our method operates outside the main denoising loop and reduces reference tokens before the main denoising stage begins. It directly provides a standard, shortened token sequence to the base model without altering internal model structures or operations, allowing existing in-model methods to be directly applied on top of our reduced sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段级兼容性：大多数现有的加速方法以模型内 token 削减的方式运行，即在主去噪循环内对 token 进行剪枝或合并。 相比之下，我们的方法在主去噪循环之外运行，并在主去噪阶段开始之前削减参考 token。 它直接向基础模型提供一个标准的、缩短后的 token 序列，而不改变模型内部的结构或操作，使得现有的模型内方法可以直接应用于我们削减后的序列之上。

paragraphs.en: Consequently, our early token reduction can be seamlessly combined with these existing acceleration techniques to achieve compounded efficiency improvement in diffusion-based visual generation tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们的早期 token 削减方法可以与这些现有的加速技术无缝结合，在基于扩散的视觉生成任务中实现叠加的效率提升。

paragraphs.en: In literature, methods compressing tokens before the main network backbone are broadly termed “pre-model” token reduction. In this paper, we primarily refer to our method as “early” token reduction to avoid ambiguity. Since our framework executes a lightweight downsampled self-probing stage using the DiT model itself to extract importance scores, the DiT model has already been executed before the token reduction takes place. Therefore, strictly calling it “pre-model” might be misleading. We instead adopt the term “early” token reduction to precisely denote that reference tokens are reduced at an early stage (prior to the main denoising stage).
paragraphs.zh: 在文献中，在主干网络之前对词元进行压缩的方法被广泛称为“模型前”词元缩减。 为避免歧义，本文将我们的方法主要称为“早期”词元缩减。 由于我们的框架使用 DiT 模型本身执行一个轻量级的下采样自探测阶段来提取重要性分数，因此在词元缩减发生之前，DiT 模型已经被执行过了。 因此，严格地将其称为“模型前”可能会产生误导。 我们改用“早期”词元缩减这一术语，以准确表示参考词元在早期阶段（主去噪阶段之前）被缩减。

paragraphs.en: In addition to the default timestep-mapped reduction (Sec 3.3.2 ), our framework seamlessly supports reducing reference tokens just once for the entire main denoising loop. By averaging the reference utilization scores across all probing steps, tokens can be filtered once before the main loop begins. Note that both modes share the same fundamental principle: reference tokens are always pruned or substituted outside the DiT in the main denoising, requiring zero structural or operational changes to the DiT in the main loop. We default (all experiments in the paper) to timestep-mapped reduction simply because matching the reference retention to the evolving demands across different denoising stages offers a slight performance gain.
paragraphs.zh: 除了默认的时间步映射缩减方式（第 3.3.2 节）之外，我们的框架还可以无缝支持仅在整个主去噪循环开始前一次性缩减参考 token。 通过对所有探测步骤的参考利用率得分取平均，可以在主循环开始之前一次性完成 token 的过滤。 需要注意的是，两种模式共享相同的基本原则：参考 token 的剪枝或替换始终在主去噪过程中的 DiT 之外完成，因此无需对主循环中的 DiT 做任何结构或操作上的改动。 我们默认采用时间步映射缩减方式（论文中的所有实验均如此），仅仅是因为让参考 token 的保留量与不同去噪阶段不断变化的需求相匹配，能够带来轻微的性能提升。

paragraphs.en: The most recent methods LoT Diffusion [ 40 ] and BudgetPix [ 23 ] introduce adaptive tokenization by assigning variable-sized patches based on visual complexity. Fundamentally, our tri-tier reduction strategy (preserving full-resolution tokens for critical details and substituting mid-importance regions with downsampled tokens) also functions as a dynamic resolution-based efficient encoding . Our token importance and multi-resolution layout are directly determined by the DiT itself through cheap downsampled self-probing in a fully training-free manner.

paragraphs.en: Our downsampled self-probing mechanism aligns with the coarse-to-fine philosophy widely adopted across diverse fields outside diffusion acceleration, such as coarse-to-fine Transformer [ 26 , 52 ] , and high-resolution generation [ 29 , 76 ] ; Sparse and 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ​ log ⁡ N ) \mathcal{O}(N\log N) attention mechanisms [ 63 , 72 , 49 ] also adopt a comparable rationale, utilizing coarse-grained block selection or hierarchical structures to guide fine token-level interactions. Crucially, while they operate at the attention level , our framework instantiates a model-level coarse-to-fine paradigm: we first deploy a coarse run to probe reference token sparsity upfront, which then governs the token allocation for the subsequent fine run.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的下采样自探查机制与扩散加速之外多个领域广泛采用的由粗到细理念相一致，例如由粗到细的 Transformer [26, 52] 以及高分辨率生成 [29, 76]；稀疏与 𝒪(N log N) 注意力机制 [63, 72, 49] 也采用了类似的原理，利用粗粒度的块选择或层级结构来引导细粒度的 token 级交互。 至关重要的是，尽管它们在注意力层面运作，我们的框架则实例化了一种模型层面的由粗到细范式：我们首先部署一次粗粒度运行来预先探查参考 token 的稀疏性，随后由其主导后续细粒度运行中的 token 分配。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on three base models: the latent-space Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) Flux.2-Klein-4B and Qwen-Image-Edit-2511, and HiDream-O1-Image, a Pixel-level Unified Transformer (UiT) that directly processes raw pixels without a VAE. Evaluating on these two architectures confirms our method is effective for diverse generic reference-based generation models. For all base models, we use their official code and default configurations. paragraphs.en: We also support a threshold-based decision policy for sample-difficulty awareness, where fixed absolute thresholds τ 1 \tau_{1} and τ 2 \tau_{2} are applied directly to the normalized reference utilization score I ~ norm \tilde{I}_{\text{norm}} . The primary benefit of this strategy is sample-difficulty awareness: for complex reference scenes requiring rich context, the model naturally allocates high attention over broader regions, automatically preserving a larger token budget; simpler references with clean backgrounds are pruned more aggressively.

sents.en: The primary benefit of this strategy is sample-difficulty awareness: for complex reference scenes requiring rich context, the model naturally allocates high attention over broader regions, automatically preserving a larger token budget; simpler references with clean backgrounds are pruned more aggressively.
sents.zh: 这种策略的主要好处是样本难度感知：对于需要丰富上下文的复杂参考场景，模型自然会在更广的区域上分配较高的注意力，自动保留更大的 token 预算；而背景干净的简单参考则会被更激进地剪枝。

paragraphs.en: MultiBanana [ 41 ] is a challenging benchmark for multi-reference image generation, consisting of 3K+ samples with up to 8 reference images. For the two-reference setting, it covers 11 editing tasks including subject addition, replacement, background change, color/material/pose/hairstyle/makeup modification, tone transformation, style transfer, and text correction. For the ≥ 3 \geq 3 references setting, it includes four tasks: object composition, background composition, local attribute transfer, and global tone edit. The benchmark incorporates four difficulty axes: cross-domain diversity (e.g., mixing photos, anime, and sketches), scale and viewpoint differences, rare concept references (e.g., a red banana), and multilingual references (English, Chinese, and Japanese), comprehensively evaluating the model’s ability on multi-reference generation tasks. MultiBanana uses a VLM to score generation quality from five dimensions: Text-Instruction Alignment, Reference Consistency, Background-Subject Match, Physical Realism, and Visual Quality, each on a 10-point scale. To align with our focus on multi-reference efficiency setting, our main experiment targets all multi-reference tasks (excluding the pure instruction-based editing task in MultiBanana). We report the mean across tasks for each quality dimension.
paragraphs.zh: MultiBanana [ 41 ] 是一个具有挑战性的多参考图像生成基准，包含 3K+ 样本，每个样本最多含 8 张参考图像。 在双参考设置下，它涵盖 11 项编辑任务，包括主体添加、替换、背景更改、颜色/材质/姿态/发型/妆容修改、色调变换、风格迁移和文本修正。 在 ≥ 3 \geq 3 张参考图像的设置下，它包括四项任务：物体组合、背景组合、局部属性迁移和全局色调编辑。 该基准包含四个难度维度：跨域多样性（例如混合照片、动漫和素描）、尺度和视角差异、稀有概念参考（例如红色的香蕉）以及多语言参考（英语、中文和日语），全面评估模型在多参考生成任务上的能力。 MultiBanana 使用 VLM 从五个维度对生成质量打分：文本指令对齐、参考一致性、背景-主体匹配、物理真实性和视觉质量，每个维度均为 10 分制。 为了与我们关注的多参考高效设置保持一致，我们的主要实验针对所有多参考任务（不包括 MultiBanana 中纯基于指令的编辑任务）。 我们报告每个质量维度在各任务上的均值。

paragraphs.en: VisPruner [ 67 ] first extracts an importance score for each visual token from a vision encoder’s self-attention. If the encoder has a CLS token, importance is the CLS-to-patch attention; if not (e.g., SigLIP), it averages attention over the query axis. It then keeps a budget of tokens by selecting the top-scoring important subset and filling the rest via iterative cosine-similarity deduplication for diversity. For HiDream-O1-Image, we reuse the model’s built-in Qwen3-VL vision encoder to score reference tokens. For FLUX.2 Klein, the model has no vision encoder, so we follow VisPruner’s default and use CLIP (ViT-L/14-336) for importance. Because CLIP patches do not match Flux’s VAE-packed reference tokens, we compute CLS-to-patch attention at CLIP’s native resolution and bilinearly map the score map onto the Flux reference grid, yielding a spatially aligned importance map for subsequent stages. Important and diverse token selection then proceeds as in VisPruner, with cosine deduplication on the packed VAE latents that enter the DiT. For Qwen-Image-Edit, we reuse the built-in Qwen2.5-VL vision encoder to score tokens. Importance is computed on the pipeline’s 384 × 384 384\times 384 condition views and bilinearly mapped onto the VAE-packed reference grid; VisPruner then selects important and diverse tokens with cosine deduplication on those packed VAE latents.
paragraphs.zh: VisPruner [67] 首先从视觉编码器的自注意力中为每个视觉 token 提取重要性分数。 如果编码器有 CLS token，重要性即为 CLS 到 patch 的注意力；如果没有（例如 SigLIP），则在 query 轴上对注意力取平均。 随后，它通过选取得分最高的重要子集，并借助迭代余弦相似度去重来填补其余 token 以保证多样性，从而保留一个预算内的 token 集合。 对于 HiDream-O1-Image，我们复用模型内置的 Qwen3-VL 视觉编码器来为参考 token 打分。 对于 FLUX.2 Klein，该模型没有视觉编码器，因此我们遵循 VisPruner 的默认设置，使用 CLIP（ViT-L/14-336）计算重要性。 由于 CLIP 的 patch 与 Flux 经 VAE 打包的参考 token 不一一对应，我们在 CLIP 的原生分辨率下计算 CLS 到 patch 的注意力，并将分数图双线性映射到 Flux 的参考网格上，从而得到空间对齐的重要性图，供后续阶段使用。 之后，重要且多样的 token 选取过程与 VisPruner 相同，即在进入 DiT 的打包 VAE 潜变量上执行余弦去重。 对于 Qwen-Image-Edit，我们复用内置的 Qwen2.5-VL 视觉编码器来为 token 打分。 重要性在流水线的 384 × 384 384\times 384 条件视图上计算，并双线性映射到经 VAE 打包的参考网格上；随后 VisPruner 在这些打包的 VAE 潜变量上通过余弦去重选出重要且多样的 token。

paragraphs.en: 1. This paper focuses on the efficiency drop caused by token growth when multiple reference images are used. In the single-image setting, namely pure instruction-based editing, the acceleration gain is relatively lower than in the multi-reference case.
paragraphs.zh: 1. 本文聚焦于使用多张参考图像时由 token 增长导致的效率下降问题。 在单图像设置下，即纯基于指令的编辑，其加速增益相对低于多参考图像的情形。

sents.en: This paper focuses on the efficiency drop caused by token growth when multiple reference images are used.
sents.zh: 本文聚焦于使用多张参考图像时由 token 增长导致的效率下降问题。

sents.en: In the single-image setting, namely pure instruction-based editing, the acceleration gain is relatively lower than in the multi-reference case.
sents.zh: 在单图像设置下，即纯基于指令的编辑，其加速增益相对低于多参考图像的情形。

paragraphs.en: 2. The empirical validation of our framework is currently limited to multi-reference-based image generation. In principle, the underlying strategy of early downsampled self-probing to identify spatial redundancy can be transferred to broader visual tasks like ViTs, VLMs, and long video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 2. 目前，我们框架的实证验证仅限于基于多参考的图像生成。 原则上，用于识别空间冗余的早期下采样自探测这一底层策略可以迁移到更广泛的视觉任务中，例如 ViT、VLM 以及长视频生成。
